Class GameObject

java.lang.Object
core.entities.base.GameObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
Collectible, Cookie, HealthItem, Obstacle
public abstract class GameObject extends Object
Base class for every object in the game. Used for: - Player - Obstacles - Collectibles Provides: - Position - Size - Collision detection - Basic object lifecycle
